name: El Bohodón (Spain)
description: Vertical tricolour of blue, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of El Bohodón (roundels on yellow, a tower and waves).
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 22 November 2001 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 27 of 7 February 2002); the flag is described as divided into three parts vertically.

features.role: El Bohodón arms — roundels, tower and waves
